fixed_constraints: Track dimension explicitly rather than hiding its dependence in unspecified constants.
Give every primitive operation on an unknown object an explicit information and cost contract; lower-level optimization is not free unless an expressly declared oracle supplies it.
scope_description: Explore informative oracle and model transfers from single-objective settings. Consider exact-value versus noisy-value interfaces and transfers to explicitly identified bilevel layers. Preserve the distinction between native information, information simulation, and a reduced-objective oracle.
